basis: deliverable Gibbs-EXCESS uptake between the stated full and empty states (M1 fix; v_a-free by identity)

u_required_2025_sensitivity_rho500.note: v1 model, 0.0005 u-grid; rho_skel over the carbon class range and residual excess uptake u_res at the empty state (0.006 = AX-21's own posterior-median residual). u_res has no effect at rho=500 because the 2025 boundary there is VOLUMETRIC-limited in the v1 model (VC binds at 0.040 while GC has slack), and the residual term adds carried mass only.
